verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a journal-entries API endpoint, a draft or pending status for journals, or a review or approval queue where an accountant signs off on agent-created entries. The general API-parity claim and the note that invited accountants can handle journal entries are adjacent evidence only. They do not show an agent drafting entries via the API and routing them to a review queue.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
